entityTypes.name: Release
entityTypes.description: Timeboxed release container scoping work items, capabilities, and artifacts

entityTypes.name: Workstream
entityTypes.description: Cross-team delivery thread grouping related work items and capabilities

entityTypes.name: WorkItem
entityTypes.description: Trackable work unit (Epic/Feature/PBI/Bug/Task) linked to ALM

entityTypes.name: Artifact
entityTypes.description: Produced document with artifact_kind metadata (scope brief, validation report, release notes, minutes, BOM delta)

entityTypes.name: Component
entityTypes.description: CMDB/BOM inventory item (hardware, infra, licensed software)

entityTypes.name: BOMSnapshot
entityTypes.description: Bill of Materials snapshot capturing component versions at a point in time

entityTypes.name: CMDBSnapshot
entityTypes.description: Configuration Management Database snapshot capturing deployment state

relationTypes.name: relates_to
relationTypes.description: Generic relation (use specific relations when possible)

relationTypes.name: scopes
relationTypes.description: Release scopes work items, capabilities, or decisions

relationTypes.name: delivers
relationTypes.description: Workstream delivers capabilities or work items

relationTypes.name: tracks
relationTypes.description: Work item tracks a gap, risk, or recommendation

relationTypes.name: documents
relationTypes.description: Artifact documents a decision, service, or process

relationTypes.name: validates
relationTypes.description: Artifact validates a work item, service, or release

relationTypes.name: impacts
relationTypes.description: Work item impacts a service or component

relationTypes.name: depends_on
relationTypes.description: Dependency between work items or services

relationTypes.name: has_version
relationTypes.description: Component version captured in BOM snapshot

relationTypes.name: deployed_in
relationTypes.description: Component deployment state in CMDB snapshot

relationTypes.name: snapshots
relationTypes.description: BOM/CMDB snapshot taken for a specific release
